name: 68949 · Holdrege, NE
findings: ZIP 68949 (Holdrege) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68949 (Holdrege) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
